summary: The customer called to close her account due to moving and inquire about any remaining balance. The agent verified her details, informed her of a $12.50 credit balance to be refunded via check, arranged for a prepaid equipment return box to be mailed to her new address, and successfully closed the account.

evidence.text: We will be mailing a refund check for $12.50 to your new address.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Mail a refund check for $12.50 to the customer's new address.

evidence.text: I will mail the equipment return box out today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Mail a prepaid equipment return box to the customer's new address today.

evidence.text: I can certainly help you with closing your account, ma'am. May I please have your full name and the phone number or account number associated with the service?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was consistently polite, patient, and professional throughout the call.

evidence.text: I understand. Let me check the final balance for 142 Maple Street.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent showed understanding and patience with an elderly customer who was confused about her bills.

evidence.text: I will mail the equipment return box out today. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully resolved the account closure, explained the credit balance, and arranged the equipment return box.

evidence.text: That means we owe you money, Martha. We will be mailing a refund check for $12.50 to your new address.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained account details and procedures in a clear, easy-to-understand manner for the customer.

evidence.text: You are very welcome, Martha. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your new home. Goodbye!
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent checked for further assistance, offered a warm closing, and properly said goodbye.
